name: Diploma in Architecture
description: The Diploma in Architecture (D.Arch) program at AIKTC is a 3-year technical foundation course approved by the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE Maharashtra). The program equips students with essential drafting, digital modeling, construction technology, and basic architectural design competencies. Students learn architectural drawing, construction materials, site surveying, basic CAD drafting, and scale model assembly, preparing them to assist professional architects or advance directly into degree programs.
highlights: Approved intake of 40 seats recognized by DTE Maharashtra for SSC (10th) passed candidates.
Access to specialized architecture studios, building material museums, computer CAD labs, and physical model-making workshops.
Comprehensive grounding in residential planning, working drawings, municipal approval drawing standards, and basic 3D rendering.
Lateral entry eligibility into professional degree courses (B.Arch) or immediate employment in architectural and civil design offices.
career_opportunities: Architectural Assistant, CAD/BIM Draftsman, 3D Architectural Visualizer, Site Supervisor, and Junior Interior Designer.
eligibility: S.S.C or its equivalent with at least 35% aggregate marks.
vision: To be the most sought after academic, research and practice based school of Architecture that others would wish to emulate.

labs.name: Design Studio
labs.description: Equipped with standard drawing desks, parallel rulers, and drafting boards for basic architectural graphics.

labs.name: Material Museum
labs.description: A curated collection of basic building materials, brick types, timber joints, and masonry displays.

labs.name: Computer Lab
labs.description: Computers loaded with AutoCAD and fundamental modeling software for initial computer design practice.

labs.name: Model Making Workshop
labs.description: Equipped with cutters and manual tools for scale model assembly and prototyping.

faculty: Same as B.Arch faculty (shared teaching staff).

alumni_testimonial.name: Khot Sharabil Simab
alumni_testimonial.quote: My five years at AIKTC laid the strongest foundation for who I am today as an architect. It was a place that turned ideas into real skills and dreams into direction.
